ctx.x: But anyhow, and talking about career choices — will I be an electrician or not — so there I am and I took all the exams and stuff. And one day Private Marino or whatever they called me — “yeah.” “You’ve got to go down to headquarters.” And I thought what did I do? As a matter of fact I did do something when they trained us. You know, hip — hip — hip to the left, right, right oblique, all that kind of stuff. And okay, cigarette break, 15 minutes or something. And we’d all sit down. And I pulled out a book, I’m…
That’s like figuring out codes and all that.
